note: Switching flight configurations now carries the stage separation across, not just the motors — a design that says "never separate" on the configuration you switch to was still flying the separation of the one you opened with, which cost one posted file two thirds of its altitude. Saving no longer overwrites the other configurations' separation either. The launch report's CG, CP and static margin now come from one instant and are named for it, with the angle of attack that explains them beside them. And a design restored from autosave says so when an earlier build read it in — re-open the file to pick up file-reading fixes.
